I absolutely love Chargebee! It's rich of features, very flexible and support is always friendly and ready to help. It's probably the best experience I've had in a while with any SaaS. The problem is that I don't want to handle VAT.
Chargebee does seem to have a lot more customer/subscription management features though so I would check Paddle has everything you need there.

With Chargebee I have the 'live site' linked to the prod environment with its own webhook URL... with Chargebee I can add multiple webhook URLs, so all events get sent to both dev and staging and each environment only cares about its own events.
